authority.reference: Gentoo PMS package/version grammar, cross-checked with portage.versions.catpkgsplit in Portage 3.0.81.1
authority.scope: Fields described as exact CPVs; general package atoms and deliberately lexical path tokens are outside this contract

grammar.category: ASCII alphanumeric or underscore first, followed by ASCII alphanumeric, underscore, plus, dot, or hyphen
grammar.package: ASCII alphanumeric or underscore first, followed by ASCII alphanumeric, underscore, plus, or hyphen; dot is forbidden
grammar.version: digits, zero or more dot-digits, one optional lowercase letter, then zero or more alpha, beta, pre, rc, or p suffixes with optional digits
grammar.revision: at most one trailing -r followed by digits
grammar.disambiguation: the package portion before the final version delimiter must not itself end in a complete valid version/revision
